name: City of Potosí
description: High in the Bolivian Andes at about 4,000 metres, Potosí grew in the 1500s beneath the Cerro Rico, the "rich mountain" whose silver filled Spain's treasure fleets. At its peak it rivalled London in size. Visitors can see the old Casa de la Moneda mint, colonial mansions and churches, and the lakes and aqueducts that powered the mills. Miners still work the mountain today.
